text:
She wanted to follow you, shut inside her dream

she scratched at the doors so that you would hear her,

so that you would answer she called you with screams.


Her defeated word sat down gravely

as if a deep thought occupied her,

and among her own blood she went weaving shadows,

in her faith, in her harmony, in her human substance.


We confused, she toward you, without course. ..

In the midst of two worlds totally disoriented.


Her pulse beats here, her memory in your nothing.

translation.title: She Wanted to Follow You, Shut inside Her Dream...
translation.editorial_note: This related version preserves the source's unusual spaced ellipsis before the final disorientation.
